Langstrasse — Zurich, Switzerland

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Zurich's best-known nightlife and red-light district — lively and genuinely popular, but with well-documented incidents; local press has explicitly noted that tourists have been warned against booking hotels near Langstrasse. A two-faced neighborhood, much like Porta Palazzo in Turin — which is exactly the pattern that inspired this whole project.

This link is already scoped to this area (not the whole city), using the neighbourhood's real coordinates.

Risk levels for Zurich are a qualitative judgment call based on general knowledge and public reputation of each neighbourhood, not an official geolocated crime dataset — unlike London, no open municipal dataset at this level of detail exists yet for Zurich.
Real official data point: Langstrasse sits in Kreis 4, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded an average burglary rate of 16.57 per 1,000 residents there across 3 years (2025, 2024, 2023), 162% of the 12-district average of 10.23/1,000. This figure is real, current, and official — but it covers burglaries only (not the full range of crime types) and is reported at the district level, not for Langstrasse specifically, so treat it as directional context for the wider area rather than a rating of this exact neighbourhood.
